---
title: "Explore AdaBoost"
toc: false
page-layout: full
---

AdaBoost (**Adaptive Boosting**) builds an ensemble **sequentially**. It starts
with equal weight on every training observation and fits a *decision stump*: a
depth-1 tree with one split. Before fitting the next stump, it gives more
weight to the samples the current stump misclassifies. Each later stump therefore
pays more attention to earlier mistakes. We use stumps here deliberately to
make that mechanism easy to see; AdaBoost can also use deeper trees as its base
models.

::: {.callout-tip}
## What to watch

Add stumps one at a time. Every round uses the same training observations—not a
bootstrap sample—but with a new set of observation weights. Compare the weight
carried by the samples misclassified by the current stump before and after its update. Then inspect
how the stumps cast weighted votes for one new observation and how held-out AUC
changes across rounds.
:::

```{=html}
<div id="adaboost-explorer" class="bagging-explorer adaboost-explorer" aria-label="Interactive AdaBoost explorer">
  <div class="bagging-toolbar">
    <div class="clt-buttons" aria-label="AdaBoost round controls">
      <button id="adaboost-next-round" type="button" class="regression-sampling-primary">Add next stump</button>
      <button id="adaboost-run-all" type="button">Run all stumps</button>
      <button id="adaboost-reset" type="button">Reset</button>
    </div>
    <div class="bagging-progress" aria-live="polite">
      <span>Stumps fitted:</span>
      <strong><output id="adaboost-round-count">1</output>/<span id="adaboost-total-round-count">12</span></strong>
    </div>
  </div>

  <section class="bagging-step adaboost-stump-step" aria-labelledby="adaboost-stump-heading">
    <div class="bagging-step-heading">
      <span class="bagging-step-number">1</span>
      <div>
        <h2 id="adaboost-stump-heading">Fit one decision stump using the current weights</h2>
        <p>All original training observations remain in the dataset. Their current weights determine how strongly they influence this stump's split.</p>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div id="adaboost-stump-card" class="adaboost-stump-card" aria-label="Current decision stump and its weighted error"></div>
  </section>

  <section class="bagging-step" aria-labelledby="adaboost-weight-heading">
    <div class="bagging-step-heading">
      <span class="bagging-step-number">2</span>
      <div>
        <h2 id="adaboost-weight-heading">Give misclassified samples more influence</h2>
        <p>The next stump sees the same training samples, but not with equal weight. The samples this stump misclassifies are upweighted.</p>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div id="adaboost-weight-card" class="adaboost-weight-card" aria-label="How the current stump changes training-observation weights"></div>
  </section>

  <section class="bagging-step" aria-labelledby="adaboost-vote-heading">
    <div class="bagging-step-heading">
      <span class="bagging-step-number">3</span>
      <div>
        <h2 id="adaboost-vote-heading">Pool weighted stump votes for one new observation</h2>
```

A more accurate stump receives a larger vote weight. With each stump prediction
$h_t(\mathbf{x})$ equal to 0 or 1, we compute the normalized positive vote:

$$
s_T(\mathbf{x}) =
\frac{\sum_{t=1}^{T} \alpha_t h_t(\mathbf{x})}
{\sum_{t=1}^{T} \alpha_t}.
$$

Because this is a weighted average, $0 \leq s_T(\mathbf{x}) \leq 1$. It is
a ranking score, however—not automatically a calibrated probability.

```{=html}
      </div>
    </div>

    <div id="adaboost-vote-card" class="adaboost-vote-card" aria-label="Weighted stump votes for one held-out observation"></div>
  </section>

  <section class="bagging-step" aria-labelledby="adaboost-evaluation-heading">
    <div class="bagging-step-heading">
      <span class="bagging-step-number">4</span>
      <div>
        <h2 id="adaboost-evaluation-heading">Evaluate the growing boosted ensemble</h2>
        <p>Every intermediate ensemble is evaluated against the same held-out observations. Each point includes all stumps up to that round.</p>
      </div>
    </div>
    <figure class="bagging-figure">
      <figcaption>Held-out AUC as sequential stumps are added</figcaption>
      <svg id="adaboost-auc-chart" role="img" aria-label="Held-out AUC after each AdaBoost round"></svg>
    </figure>
  </section>
</div>

The stump summaries, observation-weight changes, votes, and AUC values are
precomputed from the gas-turbine data. The page reveals real fitted stumps; it
does not train models in the browser.

<p style="margin-top: 1.5rem;"><a href="index.html">← Return to Tree-based models</a></p>

<script src="../assets/adaboost-explorer.js"></script>
<script>
(() => {
  const root = document.getElementById("adaboost-explorer");
  const explorer = window.MECE4520AdaBoostExplorer;
  if (!root || !explorer) return;

  const roundCountOutput = root.querySelector("#adaboost-round-count");
  const totalRoundCount = root.querySelector("#adaboost-total-round-count");
  const nextButton = root.querySelector("#adaboost-next-round");
  const runButton = root.querySelector("#adaboost-run-all");
  const resetButton = root.querySelector("#adaboost-reset");
  const stumpCard = root.querySelector("#adaboost-stump-card");
  const weightCard = root.querySelector("#adaboost-weight-card");
  const voteCard = root.querySelector("#adaboost-vote-card");
  const aucChart = root.querySelector("#adaboost-auc-chart");
  if (!roundCountOutput || !totalRoundCount || !nextButton || !runButton
      || !resetButton || !stumpCard || !weightCard || !voteCard || !aucChart) return;

  const colors = {
    boost: "#8558a1",
    accent: "#d77732",
    positive: "#3f8b64",
    negative: "#b64a4a",
    grid: "#d8e1e5",
    axis: "#5d6a72"
  };
  const nRounds = explorer.metadata.nRounds;
  let includedRounds = 1;
  let animationFrame = null;
  let lastFrameTime = 0;
  let isRunning = false;

  totalRoundCount.textContent = String(nRounds);

  function activeRound() {
    return explorer.rounds[includedRounds - 1];
  }

  function svgElement(name, attributes = {}) {
    const element = document.createElementNS("http://www.w3.org/2000/svg", name);
    Object.entries(attributes).forEach(([key, value]) => element.setAttribute(key, value));
    return element;
  }

  function addText(svg, text, x, y, attributes = {}) {
    const element = svgElement("text", Object.assign({ x, y }, attributes));
    element.textContent = text;
    svg.append(element);
    return element;
  }

  function scale(value, domain, range) {
    return range[0] + ((value - domain[0]) / (domain[1] - domain[0])) * (range[1] - range[0]);
  }

  function makeMetric(label, value, note) {
    const metric = document.createElement("div");
    metric.className = "adaboost-metric";
    const title = document.createElement("span");
    const number = document.createElement("strong");
    const description = document.createElement("small");
    title.textContent = label;
    number.textContent = value;
    description.textContent = note;
    metric.append(title, number, description);
    return metric;
  }

  function renderStumpCard() {
    const round = activeRound();
    stumpCard.replaceChildren();
    stumpCard.append(
      makeMetric(
        "Stump rule",
        round.root.feature + " ≤ " + round.root.threshold.toFixed(3),
        "the single split selected this round"
      ),
      makeMetric(
        "Weighted error eₜ",
        round.weightedError.toFixed(3),
        "fraction of current training weight misclassified"
      ),
      makeMetric(
        "Vote weight αₜ",
        round.alpha.toFixed(3),
        "larger when the stump has lower weighted error"
      )
    );
  }

  function weightPanel({ title, errorMass }) {
    const panel = document.createElement("div");
    panel.className = "adaboost-weight-panel";
    const heading = document.createElement("strong");
    heading.textContent = title;
    const bar = document.createElement("div");
    bar.className = "adaboost-weight-bar";
    const correctPercentage = 100 * (1 - errorMass);
    const errorPercentage = 100 * errorMass;
    const correct = document.createElement("span");
    correct.className = "adaboost-weight-correct";
    correct.style.width = correctPercentage.toFixed(1) + "%";
    correct.textContent = correctPercentage.toFixed(1) + "%";
    correct.setAttribute("aria-label", "Correctly classified samples: " + correctPercentage.toFixed(1) + "% of total weight");
    const error = document.createElement("span");
    error.className = "adaboost-weight-error";
    error.style.width = errorPercentage.toFixed(1) + "%";
    error.textContent = errorPercentage.toFixed(1) + "%";
    error.setAttribute("aria-label", "Misclassified samples: " + errorPercentage.toFixed(1) + "% of total weight");
    bar.append(correct, error);
    panel.append(heading, bar);
    return panel;
  }

  function renderWeightCard() {
    const round = activeRound();
    const misclassifiedCount = round.incorrectRows;
    const correctCount = explorer.metadata.nTraining - misclassifiedCount;
    weightCard.replaceChildren();
    const sampleSummary = document.createElement("div");
    sampleSummary.className = "adaboost-weight-sample-summary";
    const summaryHeading = document.createElement("strong");
    summaryHeading.textContent = "Sample counts (unchanged by reweighting)";
    const sampleCounts = document.createElement("div");
    sampleCounts.className = "adaboost-weight-sample-counts";
    const correctSamples = document.createElement("span");
    correctSamples.className = "adaboost-weight-sample-correct";
    correctSamples.innerHTML = "<strong>Correctly classified:</strong> "
      + correctCount.toLocaleString() + " ("
      + (100 * correctCount / explorer.metadata.nTraining).toFixed(1) + "%)";
    const misclassifiedSamples = document.createElement("span");
    misclassifiedSamples.className = "adaboost-weight-sample-error";
    misclassifiedSamples.innerHTML = "<strong>Misclassified:</strong> "
      + misclassifiedCount.toLocaleString() + " ("
      + (100 * misclassifiedCount / explorer.metadata.nTraining).toFixed(1) + "%)";
    sampleCounts.append(correctSamples, misclassifiedSamples);
    sampleSummary.append(summaryHeading, sampleCounts);
    const transition = document.createElement("div");
    transition.className = "adaboost-weight-transition";
    transition.append(
      weightPanel(
        {
          title: "Before updating weights",
          errorMass: round.weightedError
        }
      ),
      weightPanel(
        {
          title: "After updating weights",
          errorMass: round.incorrectWeightAfter
        }
      )
    );

    const detail = document.createElement("div");
    detail.className = "adaboost-weight-detail";
    const largest = document.createElement("span");
    largest.innerHTML = "<strong>Largest next weight:</strong> "
      + round.largestWeightRelativeToUniform.toFixed(2) + "× the initial equal weight";
    detail.append(largest);
    weightCard.append(sampleSummary, transition, detail);
  }

  function renderVoteCard() {
    const observation = explorer.predictionObservation;
    const round = activeRound();
    voteCard.replaceChildren();

    const votes = document.createElement("div");
    votes.className = "adaboost-votes";
    const label = document.createElement("span");
    label.className = "bagging-prediction-label";
    label.textContent = "One class vote from each stump (green = positive; red = negative)";
    const grid = document.createElement("div");
    grid.className = "adaboost-vote-grid";
    explorer.rounds.forEach((stumpRound, index) => {
      const vote = document.createElement("div");
      if (index >= includedRounds) {
        vote.className = "adaboost-vote adaboost-vote-pending";
        vote.setAttribute("aria-label", "Stump " + (index + 1) + " has not been fitted yet");
      } else {
        const isPositive = stumpRound.testPrediction === 1;
        vote.className = "adaboost-vote " + (isPositive ? "adaboost-vote-positive" : "adaboost-vote-negative");
        vote.style.setProperty("--vote-opacity", String(0.32 + 0.68 * stumpRound.alpha / explorer.rounds[0].alpha));
        vote.setAttribute(
          "aria-label",
          "Stump " + (index + 1) + ": " + (isPositive ? "positive" : "negative")
            + " vote, weight " + stumpRound.alpha.toFixed(3)
        );
        const stumpName = document.createElement("strong");
        const voteWeight = document.createElement("small");
        stumpName.textContent = "h" + (index + 1) + " = " + stumpRound.testPrediction;
        voteWeight.textContent = "α = " + stumpRound.alpha.toFixed(3);
        vote.append(stumpName, voteWeight);
      }
      grid.append(vote);
    });
    votes.append(label, grid);

    const summary = document.createElement("div");
    summary.className = "adaboost-vote-summary";
    const input = document.createElement("div");
    input.className = "bagging-prediction-input";
    const inputTitle = document.createElement("strong");
    inputTitle.textContent = "New observation (" + explorer.metadata.nFeatures + " features; label: " + observation.actualLabel + ")";
    const tableWrap = document.createElement("div");
    tableWrap.className = "bagging-feature-table-wrap";
    const table = document.createElement("table");
    table.className = "bagging-feature-table";
    table.innerHTML = "<thead><tr><th>Feature</th><th>Value</th></tr></thead>";
    const body = document.createElement("tbody");
    Object.entries(observation.features).forEach(([feature, value]) => {
      const row = document.createElement("tr");
      row.innerHTML = "<th scope=\"row\">" + feature + "</th><td>" + value.toFixed(2) + "</td>";
      body.append(row);
    });
    table.append(body);
    tableWrap.append(table);
    input.append(inputTitle, tableWrap);

    const result = document.createElement("div");
    result.className = "bagging-prediction-result";
    const resultTitle = document.createElement("span");
    const resultValue = document.createElement("strong");
    resultTitle.textContent = "Pooled positive vote after " + includedRounds + " stump" + (includedRounds === 1 ? "" : "s");
    resultValue.textContent = round.cumulativePositiveVote.toFixed(3);
    result.append(resultTitle, resultValue);
    summary.append(input, result);
    voteCard.append(votes, summary);
  }

  function renderAucChart() {
    const rounds = explorer.rounds.slice(0, includedRounds);
    const width = 900;
    const height = 300;
    const margin = { top: 22, right: 26, bottom: 52, left: 74 };
    const plotRight = width - margin.right;
    const plotBottom = height - margin.bottom;
    const aucValues = explorer.rounds.map((round) => round.testAuc);
    const minAuc = Math.floor((Math.min(...aucValues) - 0.005) * 100) / 100;
    const maxAuc = Math.ceil((Math.max(...aucValues) + 0.005) * 100) / 100;
    const x = (value) => scale(value, [1, nRounds], [margin.left, plotRight]);
    const y = (value) => scale(value, [minAuc, maxAuc], [plotBottom, margin.top]);
    aucChart.replaceChildren();
    aucChart.setAttribute("viewBox", "0 0 " + width + " " + height);
    aucChart.setAttribute("preserveAspectRatio", "xMidYMid meet");

    const title = svgElement("title", { id: "adaboost-auc-title" });
    title.textContent = "Held-out AUC as AdaBoost stumps are added";
    aucChart.append(title);
    aucChart.setAttribute("aria-labelledby", title.id);

    for (let tick = minAuc; tick <= maxAuc + 0.0001; tick += 0.01) {
      const tickY = y(tick);
      aucChart.append(
        svgElement("line", { x1: margin.left, y1: tickY, x2: plotRight, y2: tickY, class: "bagging-chart-grid" })
      );
      addText(aucChart, tick.toFixed(2), margin.left - 10, tickY + 4, { class: "bagging-chart-tick", "text-anchor": "end" });
    }
    [1, 3, 6, 9, 12].filter((tick) => tick <= nRounds).forEach((tick) => {
      addText(aucChart, String(tick), x(tick), plotBottom + 20, { class: "bagging-chart-tick", "text-anchor": "middle" });
    });
    aucChart.append(
      svgElement("line", { x1: margin.left, y1: margin.top, x2: margin.left, y2: plotBottom, class: "bagging-chart-axis" }),
      svgElement("line", { x1: margin.left, y1: plotBottom, x2: plotRight, y2: plotBottom, class: "bagging-chart-axis" })
    );
    addText(aucChart, "Number of sequential stumps", (margin.left + plotRight) / 2, height - 11, { class: "bagging-chart-axis-title", "text-anchor": "middle" });
    const yTitle = addText(aucChart, "Held-out ROC AUC", 18, (margin.top + plotBottom) / 2, { class: "bagging-chart-axis-title", "text-anchor": "middle" });
    yTitle.setAttribute("transform", "rotate(-90 18 " + ((margin.top + plotBottom) / 2) + ")");

    const path = rounds.map((round, index) => (index === 0 ? "M" : "L") + x(round.round) + " " + y(round.testAuc)).join(" ");
    aucChart.append(svgElement("path", { d: path, fill: "none", stroke: colors.boost, "stroke-width": 3 }));
    rounds.forEach((round) => {
      aucChart.append(svgElement("circle", { cx: x(round.round), cy: y(round.testAuc), r: 4.3, fill: colors.boost, stroke: "#fff", "stroke-width": 1.5 }));
    });
    const active = rounds[rounds.length - 1];
    addText(aucChart, "Round " + active.round + ": " + active.testAuc.toFixed(3), x(active.round), y(active.testAuc) - 11, { class: "bagging-chart-value", "text-anchor": active.round > nRounds - 2 ? "end" : "start", dx: active.round > nRounds - 2 ? -7 : 7 });
  }

  function render() {
    roundCountOutput.value = String(includedRounds);
    roundCountOutput.textContent = String(includedRounds);
    nextButton.disabled = includedRounds >= nRounds;
    runButton.disabled = includedRounds >= nRounds;
    renderStumpCard();
    renderWeightCard();
    renderVoteCard();
    renderAucChart();
  }

  function stopRunAll() {
    if (animationFrame !== null) {
      window.cancelAnimationFrame(animationFrame);
      animationFrame = null;
    }
    isRunning = false;
    runButton.textContent = "Run all stumps";
  }

  function advanceOneRound() {
    if (includedRounds < nRounds) {
      includedRounds += 1;
      render();
    }
  }

  function runAll(timestamp) {
    if (!isRunning) return;
    if (!lastFrameTime) lastFrameTime = timestamp;
    if (timestamp - lastFrameTime >= 115) {
      lastFrameTime = timestamp;
      if (includedRounds < nRounds) advanceOneRound();
      else {
        stopRunAll();
        return;
      }
    }
    animationFrame = window.requestAnimationFrame(runAll);
  }

  nextButton.addEventListener("click", () => {
    stopRunAll();
    advanceOneRound();
  });
  runButton.addEventListener("click", () => {
    if (isRunning) {
      stopRunAll();
      return;
    }
    if (includedRounds >= nRounds) return;
    isRunning = true;
    runButton.textContent = "Pause";
    lastFrameTime = 0;
    animationFrame = window.requestAnimationFrame(runAll);
  });
  resetButton.addEventListener("click", () => {
    stopRunAll();
    includedRounds = 1;
    render();
  });
  render();
})();
</script>
```
